David B. Dose is Professor of Marketing and Head of the Management Department and, as such, leading the Business Strategy and Marketing Group at the University of Exeter Business School. Previously, David worked at Aston Business School, the University of Jena (Germany) and the University of Koblenz (Germany). David’s research focuses on the effectiveness of marketing actions with a strong focus on causal attributions to inform policy makers’ and marketing managers’ decision making.

Dr Constantine Manolchev is a Senior Lecturer in Sustainable Futures and an award-winning educator and academic leader in AI and Responsible Management Education. He is the Business School's Sustainability Lead and PRME Champion, co-chairs the PRME Working Group in Emerging Technologies and Responsible Management Education, and represents Exeter on the PRME UK&I Steering Group.

Helena Fornwagner is a behavioural and experimental economist, and Senior Lecturer (tenured) at the University of Exeter, and an Associate of the Austrian Institute of Economic Research (WIFO). She serves as Co-Director for Research Ethics of the Business School Research Ethics Committee (UoEBS-REC).

Helena completed her PhD in Economics at the University of Innsbruck in 2017, followed by postdoctoral roles at Innsbruck and the University of Regensburg, before joining Exeter's Economics Department in autumn 2022. She has served on various committees including hiring committees and the faculty board, and brings extensive experience in teaching, research, and securing external funding and grants.

Professor Sonia Oreffice is Chief Diversity Officer at the University of Exeter Business School and Professor of Economics. She joined Exeter in 2018 and previously held academic positions at the University of Surrey, Universidad de Alicante, CCNY-CUNY, and Clemson University. Sonia holds a PhD in Economics from the University of Chicago and is an Editor of the Review of Economics of the Household and a Research Fellow at IZA, the Family Inequality Working Group, and CHILD.

Kemeneth (Cornish for ‘community’), the Cornwall LGBTQ+ Staff Network, welcomes all LGBTQ+ staff and allies at the University of Exeter Cornwall campuses, Falmouth University, FX Plus and The SU. Kemeneth was launched in 2023 to help create an inclusive environment for all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions at our organisations and to celebrate the wonderfully diverse campus community we have in Cornwall.
